body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-02-14 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "we have improved the EBITDA margins from as low as 1% to 7% in the current year, and we believe it will stay at this levels of 7% to 8% going forward also" Metric: Fasttel EBITDA margin. Target: 7-8%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: May-25: FY25 Fasttel EBITDA 'closer to 2.9%'. FY26: EBITDA loss INR 186 cr in 9M; INR 515 cr standalone provision in Q4; Brazil projects wrapped up. Explanation given: old-project losses, Brazil currency (prompted, Oct-25 and Feb-26: 'a setback for us')
